scope: developmental realization principle; normative morphology comparison separated from bounded morphogenetic search

rows.name: Pareto admissibility
rows.statement: Among morphologies realizing the same registered semantic obligation at matched capability, any realization weakly worse on every registered raw resource coordinate and strictly worse on at least one is realization-dominated.
rows.ocm_residual: none at theorem level; GMI supplies common machine-intelligence semantics

rows.name: Price-conditioned ranking reversal
rows.statement: If two feasible realizations have incomparable nonnegative resource vectors, different prospectively declared nonnegative price vectors can prefer different realizations when each has a priced coordinate advantage not overwhelmed by the rest.
assumptions: linear nonnegative scalarization for the stated version

rows.name: Affine lifetime horizon crossover
rows.statement: For C_i(H)=A_i+H c_i, if A_1>A_2 and c_1<c_2, the unique crossover is H*=(A_1-A_2)/(c_2-c_1).
assumptions: constant expected per-use costs over registered regime
rows.ocm_residual: none; used as calibration for developmental lifetime accounting

rows.name: Discovery-cost reversal
rows.statement: A realization with lower serving burden is worse in complete lifetime burden when its extra discovery/build burden exceeds all serving savings over the registered effective horizon.

rows.name: Normative optimum does not imply discoverability
rows.statement: An oracle optimum over the admissible realization class does not imply a bounded developmental/morphogenetic search can identify or reach it. Exact global optimization is unavailable in unrestricted expressive spaces without additional restrictions.
assumptions: normative candidate class distinguished from search process
rows.ocm_residual: forces separate realization-frontier and morphogenetic-search claims

rows.name: Semantic admissibility precedes efficiency
rows.statement: A resource-efficient candidate that does not preserve the registered semantic obligation is not an admissible realization and cannot occupy the realization frontier.
assumptions: semantic obligation fixed before resource comparison
rows.ocm_residual: prevents weakening correctness to win efficiency

rows.name: Realization equivalence does not imply resource equivalence
rows.statement: Two morphologies can implement the same semantic developmental state and future semantic traces while occupying different capability-resource frontiers.
rows.ocm_residual: supports morphology comparison after semantic quotienting

rows.name: Morphology phase boundaries are ecology-relative
rows.statement: If the preferred frontier occupant changes only after changing ecology, horizon, verifier strength, hardware/resource prices, drift or development protocol, the transition is conditional on those registered variables rather than evidence of a universally superior morphology.
assumptions: candidate set and comparison semantics held fixed except registered phase variable
rows.parent_owner: statistical decision theory / algorithm selection / bounded rationality

rows.name: Search quality and realization quality are independent axes
rows.statement: A morphogenetic process can cheaply find a poor realization or expensively find an excellent realization; reporting only deployment quality or only search cost is insufficient for developmental comparison.
assumptions: search/discovery burden is accounted separately from realized serving/update burden
rows.parent_owner: AutoML / NAS / program synthesis evaluation methodology

rows.name: No universal best realization
rows.statement: GMI-v1 does not license one morphology as universally optimal across unrestricted ecologies/resource valuations; any strong dominance claim is scoped to a registered obligation/ecology/resource regime.

rows.name: Semantic-state information lower bound and factorization interpretation
rows.statement: For a finite exact semantic sufficient-state set with N pairwise future-distinguishable states, a lossless fixed-length binary encoding requires at least ceil(log2 N) bits. Thus N=3^n implies Theta(n) state-information bits, not Theta(3^n). Any exponential factorization advantage must identify another quantity such as global model/transition enumeration, search enumeration, or update/revision work.
assumptions: pairwise future-distinguishable under the registered obligation
fixed-length binary encoding for the stated bound
rows.ocm_residual: prevents false exponential current-state compression claims and separates state information from model/update complexity

forbidden_inference: phase law from post-hoc architecture labels
morphogenesis claim from normative optimum alone
efficiency win from weakened verifier/capability semantics
exponential current-state information cost inferred from exponentially many global configurations
